author: THSV StreamBridge
description: Your own soundboard: buttons of sounds that play on stream from the Control Panel, a chat command or a channel point reward, in any streaming app.
changelog: 4.1.140: aligned with THSV StreamBridge 4.1.140, guided wizard UI, verified update metadata, and regenerated Streamer.bot imports. Initial release.

manifest.name: Soundboard
installationSteps: Add your sounds: give each a name, press Choose file to pick an MP3, WAV or OGG file, and set its volume.
Optional: give a sound a chat command (such as airhorn for !airhorn) or paste a Twitch or Kick channel point reward ID.
Add http://127.0.0.1:8787/overlay/addons/thsv.soundboard as a browser source in each scene where sounds should be heard. Add it on one canvas only, so each sound is heard once.
Enable the extension and restart StreamBridge. Play sounds from the Control Panel, chat or rewards.
uninstallationSteps: Disable the extension and remove its browser source.

healthChecks.description: Checks sound matching for commands and rewards, cooldowns and who may play sounds.
